name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Choose to auto-generate transcripts for every new video on upload. The upside is immediate link coverage growth—no waiting for human transcription, so we hit +5%/day faster. The trade-off is accepting lower accuracy on niche terms; we’ll flag errors in the Public Regret Ledger and prioritize fixes in the next sprint.

name: Scriv
text: Auto-generating transcripts trades long-term trust for short-term speed. The Public Regret Ledger won’t fix niche errors fast enough—users will hit dead ends on critical terms, and the ledger becomes noise, not a signal. Instead, run auto-generation only on videos with high-confidence terms; flag the rest for human review. Settle it by measuring user drop-off on auto-transcribed videos versus human-reviewed ones over two weeks.

name: Chisel
text:
Auto-generate transcripts for every new video on upload. Speed beats perfection here—we need +5% daily coverage to open the access gate, and waiting for human review or confidence checks slows us down. The trade-off is accepting lower accuracy on niche terms; we’ll log every error in the Public Regret Ledger and prioritize fixes based on user impact, not sentiment. This keeps us moving toward 100% while the ledger gives us a clear path to clean up the mess later.

name: Sift
text: Auto-generating every transcript trades long-term credibility for a short-term coverage bump—users will hit dead ends on critical terms, and the Public Regret Ledger becomes noise, not a signal. Instead, run auto-generation only on videos with high-confidence terms; flag the rest for human review to keep the ledger meaningful. Settle it with a controlled A/B test: measure user drop-off on auto-only vs. hybrid transcripts over two weeks.
